For a Toronto local business where the KPI is actual enquiries/leads—not reach, impressions or video views—I’d shortlist agencies that explicitly connect Meta Ads to CRM, calls, booked appointments, or qualified leads.

Shortlist

ORCAFY Marketing Agency — Their Meta offering specifically covers qualified lead forms, lead-quality scoring, CRM integration and tracking through to closed deals. Their published reporting includes CPL, qualified leads and revenue impact. 
Orcafy

SET Marketing — Particularly relevant if you want the whole enquiry pipeline measured: their materials describe Meta/Google campaigns plus tracking from lead → contacted → booked → closed, with follow-up automation.

PPC Guru — Toronto-based performance agency with paid social/Meta and a stated focus on lead generation, calls and form fills rather than awareness.

Preeminent Marketing — North York agency offering paid social and lead-generation work; worth including if you want a broader full-service partner.

ZimaPeak Marketing Inc. — Toronto-based and explicitly focused on Meta campaigns, lead generation and conversion-oriented funnels; they also publish a local medspa case study involving Meta + Google + booking/client-management workflows.

MetaBaz — Richmond Hill/GTA rather than Toronto proper, but unusually transparent about this use case: Meta Ads, Pixel/CAPI, monthly reporting tied to leads, and published management pricing starting at $599/month. 
MetaBaz

If I were sending out 3–4 briefs, I'd include ORCAFY, SET Marketing, PPC Guru and MetaBaz—not as a ranking, but because their publicly stated services line up particularly closely with your requirement for enquiry attribution.

The key question to ask every agency

Don't ask “How many leads will you get me?” Ask:

“Can your monthly report show Meta spend → enquiries → qualified enquiries → booked appointments/jobs → revenue, and can you demonstrate how you'll attribute those outcomes back to individual campaigns?”

That's important because Meta itself supports syncing generated leads into a CRM, so an agency should be able to build a measurement workflow beyond simply reporting impressions and clicks. 
About Facebook

If you tell me what kind of Toronto business it is (e.g. dental, contractor, clinic, restaurant, professional service), I can narrow this to 3 agencies that specifically fit that type of local lead generation, including their pricing/contract approach where published.
